audit.why: 49.32% over 1766 games with Akshan holding every chart row is a fair EVEN 5.5/10 — the lane is his, the map is Twisted Fate's, which is what pulls the win rate to even.
Level 6 is genuinely Akshan's row here: Comeuppance answers Destiny because Destiny reveals him first. TF's spikes are Destiny at 6 (170s at rank 1) and lost-tempo roams, not lane damage.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four fields give Akshan a stun on E, and two give Stacked Deck a shield.
audit.why: Heroic Swing has no crowd control at all — it is a grapple swing that fires at the nearest enemy and is knocked off on champion or terrain collision. Stacked Deck is bonus damage every fourth attack plus attack speed; there is no shield in it. The shield in this matchup is Akshan's own passive, off three hits. Pick a Card is an attack reset: the card fires on his next attack, so his attack wind-up is the tell rather than the W cast, and Wild Cards is only a 6s cooldown, not a long one.
audit.corrected: Stun removed from whys[1], wants.you[1], spikes[2] and early; Stacked Deck's shield removed from spikes[2] and late; the attack-reset tell added to breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0] calls Wild Cards a long cooldown; nothing states a real number.
audit.why: Wild Cards is 6/5.75/5.5/5.25/5; Pick a Card is a flat 6s; Destiny is 170/140/110.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into spikes[0], breakdown.cooldowns, ahead and breakdown.feeding.

edits.before: You out-trade Twisted Fate at levels 1-2 as long as you respect his card range — his Wild Card has no reliable stun until he lands the gold card, so you can shove with Avengerang and step up for short trades. From level 3 onward your kit snowballs faster: E lets you swing in, stun, and combo before he can safely reposition, and his card cooldowns are long enough that a single dodged poke leaves him defenseless.
edits.after: You out-trade Twisted Fate at levels 1-2 as long as you respect his card range — Wild Cards is a 6s poke and nothing locks you down until he loads the gold card, so you can shove with Avengerang and step up for short trades. From level 3 onward your kit snowballs faster: Heroic Swing closes the gap, three hits buy you the passive shield, and one dodged gold card leaves him with no answer at all.

edits.before: Twisted Fate's global ultimate keeps him relevant in side lanes, but in a straight 1v1 or teamfight you close the gap fast with W stealth resets and punish his card cast animations. Duskblade-style burst combined with your passive execute mark cuts through his squishy HP pool before Stack Deck's shield timer can save him twice.
edits.after: Twisted Fate's global ultimate keeps him relevant in side lanes, but in a straight 1v1 or teamfight you close the gap fast with W camouflage resets and punish his attack wind-ups. Lethality burst plus a Comeuppance that scales on missing health cuts through his squishy HP pool long before Stacked Deck's fourth attack lands twice.
